name: Volunteer with the Tippecanoe County Historical Association
what_you_do: At Fort Ouiatenon Blockhouse Museum, wear historic clothing and engage visitors in stories about the fort's history. Or help with the History on Tour traveling exhibit, or help at the Feast of the Hunters' Moon.
who_can_apply: Battlefield Museum, Genealogy Center and Collections roles say volunteers must be 18 or older. The Fort Ouiatenon, History on Tour and Feast pages do not state an age rule, so ask before you apply.
pay_detail: Unpaid. At the Feast, participants may earn one badge per 8 hour shift.
deadline_text: No deadline. Fort Ouiatenon volunteers are needed in summer.
how_to_apply: Fill out a volunteer application and attend an interview. Every role needs on-site training, and no experience is required. Call 765-476-8411 or email info@tippecanoehistory.org.
notes: Ask the museum whether 14 to 17 year olds can take the Fort Ouiatenon or History on Tour roles.
